patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: It fit PERFECT and then it didn't come back out. I can still breathe out the other side. It's the blue one — my favorite.
presentation.triageNote: 4-year-old male, placed a plastic bead in his right nostril, unilateral obstruction, breathing comfortably, with nothing to suggest a battery or magnet.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 / Non-Urgent is appropriate because this stable child is expected to need a simple removal procedure without a countable emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This is a comfortable child with a witnessed plastic bead in one nostril and no airway compromise or high-risk foreign material.
clinical.acuityReason: The child is breathing comfortably through the other nostril, has normal vital signs, and the object is reported not to be a battery or magnet.
expectedResources: Focused nasal examination and foreign-body removal
keyFindings: Object is not a battery or magnet
teachingPoints: Button batteries require urgent removal because they can rapidly injure nasal tissue.
Positive-pressure or instrument removal should be selected according to visibility, cooperation, and aspiration risk.

possibleDiagnoses: Nasal foreign body without respiratory compromise
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: The bead would likely be removed with positive pressure or an appropriate instrument, followed by discharge if the airway and nasal examination remain reassuring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting, pointing at his own nose
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 4-year-old boy, mischievous, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting, pointing at his own nose. Expression: a sheepish grin. Clearly visible: pointing at his right nostril, otherwise completely well. No text, no logos.
